summary: Planned PubMed, Global Health (Ovid), Google Scholar, and multilingual (§3 PT/NL/ON) database searches are silently omitted from search_log.csv NOT RUN rows, SEARCH_PROTOCOL.md §7, START_HERE.md, and W01.

summary: 36 of 37 included non-English/Portuguese/Dutch studies (29/30 Spanish, 6/6 French, 1/1 Slovak/Czech) violate INCLUSION_EXCLUSION.md Criterion 10 by omitting translation method and translator from extraction_note.
empirical_evidence: Direct scan of extraction_database.csv (`language` vs `extraction_note`): 30 Spanish-only, 6 French-only, and 1 Slovak/Czech study are included; only 1 Spanish row mentions translation in `extraction_note`.
recommended_fix: Audit all 37 non-EPD rows, backfill AI translation provenance in `extraction_note`, and add a verifier check enforcing Criterion 10 on non-EPD languages.

summary: Severe within-study specification and outcome multiplicity across 24 of 31 SWiM synthesis studies (77.4%), including cherry-picking partial models or secondary factors over null/opposite primary results.
empirical_evidence: Task E adversarial audit (PR #11): S471 is null (b=-1.03, SE=0.76) in the authors' designated primary Combined model (coded Favourable from partial Col. 3); S085 is null on 7 of 8 primary pre-registered tests incl. Full Sample N=6,652; S930 is null on 8/8 water and 5/8 sewerage models; S174 omits statutory sanitation-plan factor Capacidade_Politica (-1.890, p=0.033) in favour of endogenous billing revenue.
recommended_fix: Pre-specify a deterministic primary-specification selection hierarchy (authors' designated full/combined model > partial block; direct legal rule > financial proxy) and recode S471, S593, and contested rows during A30.

summary: Construct-validity dilution in SWiM: 16 of 31 synthesis studies measure indirect utility/ecological/institutional proxies rather than household water/sanitation connection or affordability.
empirical_evidence: Task E audit: S593 models Coulter's municipal inequity formula (penalizing 99%-covered low-tariff cities); S526 models 30k/6k gal tariff steepness; S749 models corporate revenue/m3 across industrial/agricultural/domestic users; S879 codes Mixed from landlord loan repayment while all 8 household WASH access outcomes (Table 7) are null.
recommended_fix: Move S593 (out-of-scope construct) to reasoned non-fits or exclude; separate household-level access outcomes from utility-tariff/revenue proxies in SWiM tables.

summary: Four of nine SWiM sensitivity scenarios (S1, S1b, S2, S3) drop 0 studies (no-ops identical to baseline), S3 fails to test probable overlap LR09 (S526/S539), and sensitivity_analysis.py omits Null counts from Family B/C rendered cells.

recommended_fix: Fix line 195 of sensitivity_analysis.py to print `+/-/null/mixed` and `Fav/Unfav/Null/Mixed` for all three families; add scenario S3b collapsing probable overlap LR09 (S526/S539) and a scenario dropping Task E `unsupported` rows.

summary: Systematic prose-skimming over regression tables and PDF Unicode minus-sign stripping in numerical extractions.
empirical_evidence: Task E found partial/rounding/table issues in 10 of 31 SWiM studies (32.3%): S398 recorded `table: none`, `SE: none`, `N=962` from prose despite Table 3 Col. 5 printing `23.479* (SE=12.189, p<0.10, N=216 across 72 tracts)`; S930 mistook adjacent `%Δ` t-stat `0.595` for a p-value; Elsevier/IWA PDFs strip `−` glyphs in Tables (`S920`, `S930`, `S1062`, `S1162`).
recommended_fix: Correct the 10 SWiM table/SE/N records identified in Task E and disclose prose-vs-table extraction error rates once Task C (60-study second extraction) is scored.

summary: AI-framed adjudication sheets risk anchoring human (`CK`) rulings across the 262 adjudicated records.
empirical_evidence: In A16, A22, A24, A25, A26, and A28, the primary AI selected paper excerpts, framed binary options, and printed its recommended verdict adjacent to the human fill-in column; A6_TIER3_EVIDENCE_CARDS_2026-11-15.md likewise includes AI extraction and AI reasoning on the card.
recommended_fix: Disclose AI-framed dossier anchoring alongside the 20.2% human-verified figure, and keep `saw_AI_reasoning_before_deciding` audit tracking strict for remaining A6/A30 passes.

summary: 18 secondary reviews (AMSTAR 2, including scoping/integrative hybrids) are counted inside the 1,072 included studies without checking primary-study overlap against the 1,054 primary studies; S879 still carries an unverified RoB 2 placeholder string.
empirical_evidence: CURRENT_FIGURES.md counts 18 AMSTAR 2 reviews in the 1,072 corpus; extraction_database.csv S879 `risk_of_bias_tool` still reads `randomization unit (compound-level) inferred ... verify against source paper before finalizing rating` despite full PDF showing Exp. 1 compound-randomized (N=2,584) and Exp. 2 street-cluster-randomized (142 streets, N=1,001); S294 RoB 2 has mechanism_certainty=3 vs 4 on the other 4 RoB 2 rows.
recommended_fix: Separate primary studies (1,054) from secondary reviews (18) in headline tables, audit citation overlap for the 18 reviews, and finalize S879's RoB 2 string.

summary: Web of Science (`SEARCH_035`, 4,058 records) has unconfirmed Core Collection index/edition selection and unconfirmed pre-export hit total.
empirical_evidence: search_log.csv row 37 (`SEARCH_035`) states `UNCONFIRMED -- which Core Collection indexes (SCI-EXPANDED/SSCI/A&HCI/ESCI) were selected has not been reported back` and pre-export hit total `UNCONFIRMED`.

summary: Cross-platform verification crash on 64-bit Windows (`csv.field_size_limit(sys.maxsize)`), `.gitignore` blocking `gemini_review/**/*.json`, and failing EOL Python 3.8/3.9 GitHub Actions jobs.
empirical_evidence: Running `verify_repository.py` on Windows 64-bit Python 3.12 raises `OverflowError: Python int too large to convert to C long` at current_figures.py:18 and validate_schemas.py:41; root `.gitignore` line 32 `*.json` ignores `gemini_review/`; CI fails on Python 3.8/3.9.
recommended_fix: Replace `sys.maxsize` with `min(sys.maxsize, 2**31 - 1)`, add `!legal-last-mile-systematic-review/gemini_review/**/*.json` to `.gitignore`, and drop EOL Python 3.8/3.9 from `.github/workflows/`.

summary: Class base-rate leakage in second-AI task headers when Tier 3 (100% AI includes) and Tier 2 (100% AI excludes) are run as separate named batches.
empirical_evidence: GEMINI_HANDOFF_BRIEF_2026-11-17.md §3 titles Task A `50 tier-3 includes` and Task B `102 tier-2 excludes`. Although we stripped this from `blind_screener_v2`'s prompt in Task A, running pure-include or pure-exclude batches leaks base rates to any agent reading the brief.
recommended_fix: When generating the Tier-2 blind input file, mix in seeded control includes (or combine with human-verified calibration records per A6_COMPARISON_PREREGISTRATION) without disclosing base rates.

summary: W04 claims non-EPD languages (e.g. Spanish, French) were excluded, whereas 37 Spanish/French/Slovak studies ARE included without translation logs and 0 Dutch studies were found.
empirical_evidence: extraction_database.csv holds 30 Spanish, 6 French, 1 Slovak/Czech, plus 8 bilingual Spanish/French rows, and 0 Dutch rows. Meanwhile English-only search strings excluded non-English-indexed papers at search time.
recommended_fix: Rewrite W04 to distinguish (a) English-only database search bias (excluding papers without English titles/abstracts, including Dutch) from (b) inconsistent ad-hoc inclusion of 37 Spanish/French/Slovak hits without Criterion 10 translation logs.

summary: W09 cites a 3/40 (7.5%) informal false-inclusion estimate, whereas blind second-AI screening of Tier 3 (Task A, PR #10) excluded 26 of 46 readable includes (56.5%).
empirical_evidence: Task A blind Gemini run (`gemini-4-carbon-medium`, 0/10 self-consistency flips): 26/46 readable Tier-3 AI includes excluded (13 E03 narrow Criterion 2, 5 E04 wrong outcome, 4 E05 non-empirical essays, 3 E01, 1 E07).
recommended_fix: Update W09 once CK completes the A6 Tier-3 human pass; expect substantial false-inclusion concentration among unverified broad-governance and commentary includes.

summary: W10 rates mid-stream adoption of narrow Criterion 2 as `medium` with `unknown` bias, but running W10's own date test proves a 20-fold regime shift in exclusion coding.
empirical_evidence: In exclusion_log.csv: pre-2026-10-03 (`n=1,113`) has E01=44.0% (490) and E03=3.1% (35); post-2026-10-03 (`n=92`) has E01=0.0% (0) and E03=63.0% (58). Meanwhile 785 AI-only includes were only screened on extracted flags (`A24`), not full-text re-read (which is why Task A still found 56.5% excludes).
recommended_fix: Upgrade W10 from `medium` to `high` and report the pre/post-2026-10-03 exclusion distribution directly in W10.

summary: W22 downplays that Family C's pre-stated raw-sign conclusion test (`C_test_no_dominant_sign`) actively FAILS at baseline (`8/15 = 53.3%` negative raw signs) and in 7 of 9 sensitivity scenarios.

summary: Single human investigator executing eligibility refinements and synthesis exclusions (`D09`, `D15`–`D17`) with results visible for a companion dissertation review is a `high` ROBIS governance risk, not `medium`.
empirical_evidence: DEVIATIONS_AND_ERRORS.md lines 19–27: 4 departures (`D12`, `D15`, `D16`, `D17`) and 2 partial departures (`D09`, `D10`) were made by a single investigator after results existed.
recommended_fix: Rate W23 `high` to match ROBIS / Cochrane standards and publish a pre-ruling (`k=44`) vs post-ruling (`k=31`) SWiM comparison table (`W21` quick win).

summary: W30 claims `VERIFIER_MUTATION_MAP_2026-10-04.md` records what the verifier `does and does not catch`, when in fact the file shows `27 of 27 defects caught` (0 UNCAUGHT) and quotes stale `1,159` counts.

summary: Lack of SHA-256 file manifests for 1,041 of 1,072 included studies (plus `.pdf`-named HTML files on Drive such as `RA13F19846E9D`) is a `medium` auditability barrier, not `low`.
empirical_evidence: Task A found `RA13F19846E9D` stored on Drive as `.pdf` when its bytes are SciELO HTML; `A14` previously found ~20 Drive `.pdf` files were portal landing pages.
recommended_fix: Run a non-copyright-infringing metadata manifest script over the Drive folder recording `(record_id, study_id, mime_detected, bytes, sha256, pages, text_chars)` for all held files.
